import os
import requests

BASE_URL = os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "https://api.socbench.example").rstrip("/")
ASSESSMENT_ID = os.getenv("ASSESSMENT_ID", "YOUR_ASSESSMENT_ID")
NEW_STATUS = os.getenv("ASSESSMENT_STATUS", "under-review")

session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({"Accept": "application/json"})

report = {}

try:
    response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/inventory-overview", timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    report["inventory_overview"] = response.json()

    response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/transport-routes", timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    report["recommended_transport_routes"] = response.json()

    response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/materials", timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    report["material_specifications"] = response.json()

    response = session.patch(
        f"{BASE_URL}/impact-assessment/{ASSESSMENT_ID}/status",
        json={"status": NEW_STATUS},
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    report["assessment_status_update"] = response.json() if response.content else {
        "status": NEW_STATUS
    }

    print(report)

        "parameters": {

            "raw_material_costs": "stable",

    },
)
